title.zh: 规定修建一条国家公路，从南拉瑙省塔戈隆市镇的南拉瑙省内环路起，经南拉瑙省塔戈隆市镇描笼涯 Malimbato 交叉路口，至布基农省塔拉卡格市镇，并连接伊里甘市描笼涯 Pugaan 至国家公路的支线、以及通过南拉瑙省卡派市镇通往马拉维市国家公路的支线，该国家公路定名为穆斯林—基督徒团结公路，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Construction of a National Highway From Lanao Del Norte Interior Circumferential Road in the Municipality of Tagoloan, Province of Lanao Del Norte to the Municipality of Talakag, Province of Bukidnon, With a Crossroad At Barangay Malimbato, Municipality of Tagoloan, Province of Lanao Del Norte and Connecting Roads to the National Highway in Iligan City Through Barangay Pugaan, Iligan City and to the National Highway in Marawi City Through the Municipality of Kapai, Province of Lanao Del Sur, to Be Known as the Muslim-Christian Unity Highway and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật quy định xây dựng Đường cao tốc Quốc gia từ Đường vành đai nội bộ Lanao Del Norte tại Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Tagoloan, Tỉnh Lanao Del Norte đến Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Talakag, Tỉnh Bukidnon, với ngã rẽ tại Barangay Malimbato, Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Tagoloan, Tỉnh Lanao Del Norte và các đường nối đến Đường cao tốc Quốc gia tại Thành phố Iligan qua Barangay Pugaan, Thành phố Iligan và đến Đường cao tốc Quốc gia tại Thành phố Marawi qua Thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Kapai, Tỉnh Lanao Del Sur, được đặt tên là Đường Cao tốc Đoàn kết Hồi giáo–Kitô giáo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดการก่อสร้างทางหลวงแห่งชาติจากถนนวงแหวนภายในจังหวัดลานาโอดิลนอร์เตที่เมืองตาโกโลอันจังหวัดลานาโอดิลนอร์เตถึงเมืองตาลาคากจังหวัดบูกิดนอนโดยมีทางแยกที่บารังไกย์มาลิมบาโตเมืองตาโกโลอันจังหวัดลานาโอดิลนอร์เตและมีถนนเชื่อมต่อไปยังทางหลวงแห่งชาติในเมืองอิลีแกนผ่านบารังไกย์ปูกาอันเมืองอิลีแกนและไปยังทางหลวงแห่งชาติในเมืองมาราวีผ่านเมืองกาไพจังหวัดลานาโอดิลซูร์เพื่อใช้ชื่อว่าทางหลวงแห่งชาติเพื่อความสามัคคีระหว่างมุสลิมกับคริสต์
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengatur Pembangunan Jalan Nasional dari Jalan Lingkar Dalam Lanao Del Norte di Kotamadya Tagoloan, Provinsi Lanao Del Norte ke Kotamadya Talakag, Provinsi Bukidnon, dengan simpang di Barangay Malimbato, Kotamadya Tagoloan, Provinsi Lanao Del Norte dan jalan penghubung ke Jalan Nasional di Kota Iligan melalui Barangay Pugaan, Kota Iligan dan ke Jalan Nasional di Kota Marawi melalui Kotamadya Kapai, Provinsi Lanao Del Sur, yang dikenal sebagai Jalan Raya Persatuan Muslim–Kristen
title.ms: Akta Menetapkan Pembinaan Jalan Persekutuan dari Jalan Lingkaran Dalaman Lanao Del Norte di Bandar Tagoloan, Wilayah Lanao Del Norte ke Bandar Talakag, Wilayah Bukidnon, dengan persimpangan di Barangay Malimbato, Bandar Tagoloan, Wilayah Lanao Del Norte dan jalan penyambung ke Jalan Persekutuan di Bandar Iligan melalui Barangay Pugaan, Bandar Iligan dan ke Jalan Persekutuan di Bandar Marawi melalui Bandar Kapai, Wilayah Lanao Del Sur, dikenali sebagai Lebuhraya Perpaduan Muslim–Kristian

text.en: There shall be constructed, under the supervision of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), a national highway from the Lanao del Norte Interior Circumferential Road in the Municipality of Tagaloan, Province of Lanao del Norte to the Municipality of Talakag, Province of Bukidnon, with a crossroad at Barangay Malimbato, Municipality of Tagaloan, Province of Lanao del Norte and connecting roads to the national highway in Iligan City through Barangay Pugaan, Iligan City and to the national highway in Marawi City through the Municipality of Kapai, Province of Lanao del Sur. The aforesaid stretch of road shall be known as the Muslim-Christian Unity Highway.

The amount necessary to defray the cost of undertaking and completing the feasibility study and detailed engineering for this project, and other activities related thereto shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act (GAA). Thereafter, the Secretary of the DPWH shall include in the Department’s program the construction of the Muslim-Christian Unity Highway, the funding of which shall be included in the annual GAA.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
